title: Mlai mid domain class imbalance
question: What are the main techniques for handling a severely imbalanced classification dataset, and what are the tradeoffs between them?
idealAnswer:
Resampling: oversampling the minority class, e.g. SMOTE, which synthesizes new minority examples rather than just duplicating, or undersampling the majority class, both risk overfitting to synthetic patterns or discarding useful majority-class information

Class weighting penalizes misclassifying the minority class more heavily in the loss function without changing the data itself, avoiding the data duplication or loss issues of resampling

Choosing an appropriate evaluation metric, precision, recall, F1, or PR-AUC rather than accuracy, matters as much as the training-time technique itself, since accuracy hides poor minority-class performance

Threshold tuning after training, adjusting the decision threshold based on the precision/recall tradeoff actually needed, rather than relying on the default 0.5 cutoff

A strong answer notes these techniques are not mutually exclusive, and the right combination depends on how severe the imbalance is and what the cost of each error type is
